title: Flint via Ollama (default tag)
slug_note: A 40B coding-agent MoE with 2.5B active, in one command; 23 GB tag.

variation.quant_detail: NVFP4, Ollama's default `flint:latest` (= `flint:40b`) tag, 23GB; quant read with `ollama show flint` on our DGX Spark (Ollama 0.40.10)
variation.revision_note: Ollama model ID shown by `ollama list` on the Spark when measured (2026-10-24)

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark: 34.4 GB resident at Ollama's default 256K context (weights + KV). Smaller boxes get a smaller default context and less KV. Earlier estimate: Estimate: the 23 GB tag plus KV headroom at a modest context. Not measured. Unsloth lists 26 GB of memory for 4-bit.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).

caveats: Ollama 0.40.10 on a 128 GB DGX Spark picked a 256K default context by itself, so memory use is well above the file size. Set num_ctx lower to save memory, or keep it for long documents.
Recursive's own serving path is SGLang on one B300/H200; this consumer route uses Ollama's quantised tag instead.
Unsloth's guide claims 125+ tok/s on an M4 Pro MacBook Pro and 150+ on a 64 GB RTX Spark; machine memory and quant per claim are not stated, so those numbers are not recorded here.
The default tag is NVFP4 (an NVIDIA Blackwell 4-bit format); Ollama also ships a `40b-a2b-q4_1` tag for other GPUs.
Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-24): `ollama run flint` answered after 8.2 s from a cold start (model files read from disk).
